PCIe Sideband Length Matching

The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` has PCIe sideband signals PERST# (50 mm), CLKREQ# (80 mm), and WAKE# (120 mm) routed on F.Cu. A continuous GND zone on B.Cu provides the reference plane. The routing lengths violate PCIe sideband matching requirements.

Re-route the three nets so that PERST# and CLKREQ# are matched within 5 mm of each other and WAKE# total length does not exceed 100 mm. All segments must remain on F.Cu referenced to the GND zone on B.Cu.

Requirements:
1. `|L(PERST#) - L(CLKREQ#)| <= 5 mm`.
2. `L(WAKE#) <= 100 mm`.
3. All three nets must have segments only on F.Cu.
4. The GND zone on B.Cu must cover the routing area, with all segment midpoints inside the GND polygon.
5. Also write `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg` as the native KiCad CLI F.Cu SVG export of your final board.

Write `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` and `/home/user/Desktop/fcu.svg`.
